entrypoint_kind: standalone; direct environment/runner construction, not a new global task_registry entry
status: Experimental active training recipe; no final behavioral acceptance or hardware-generalization guarantee.

ankle_torque_l2.formula: sum of squared robot.data.applied_torque over exactly four named ankle joints
ankle_torque_l2.channel_caveat: Implicit-actuator nominal torque estimate; not measured real motor torque or an exact recovered PhysX contact reaction.

stance_foot_speed_cost.speed: mean of four actual world-frame foot-link 3D speed norms at 200Hz; norm before averaging
stance_foot_speed_cost.phase: parent updated end-of-control-step 0.8s clock, right offset0.5; Gaussian-smoothed stance [0,0.55),sigma0.015
stance_foot_speed_cost.activation: finite max(abs(vx,vy,wz))>1e-6; disabled at zero; phase-gated, not an actual-contact gate

preserved.asset: retained ELF3 USD, approximately43.222507kg; no asset/PD/action-scale changes
preserved.feedback: existing joint_velocity_tustin_v1,20Hz observed dq; physical actuator PD unfiltered
preserved.actor: 100 proprioceptive values per frame,5 chronological frames,29 actions,deterministic mean context
preserved.standing: original still-v2 exact-zero reward gates/default leg+waist pose and phase preprocessing preserved
preserved.terrain: inherited17-level mixed terrain/course; initial levels inherited, not reset to a newly designed curriculum

randomization.gain_sampling: startup,per environment/per joint,not resampled at each reset
randomization.note: Contact friction,PD damping,armature,and motor friction are different parameters.

initialization_modes.active_run: From original still-v2 checkpoint18500, with its exact weights,Adam and saved learning rate; new rewards enabled starting18501. Parent remains read-only.
initialization_modes.fresh: Public entrypoint without --resume/--parent-checkpoint initializes random weights and empty Adam. Same final recipe does NOT reproduce the active continuation's training history.
initialization_modes.parent_checkpoint: --parent-checkpoint and explicit matching --parent-sha256 promote only a compatible original still-v2 checkpoint via initialize_from_parent; parent contract was originally made with16384 environments.
initialization_modes.same_stage_resume: --resume accepts only a full matching ankle_cost_v1 checkpoint with nonempty Adam. Existing completed iteration is excluded from additional updates; source is read-only and outputs go to a new directory.
initialization_modes.historical_recovery_scripts: scripts/resume_elf3_ankle_cost.py and resume_elf3_still_v2.py preserve the author's exact original-run recovery flow; they require its private local metadata and SwanLab ACK state, not just a checkpoint.

commands.fresh: OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_ankle_cost.py --headless --device cuda:0 --num-envs 16384 --iterations 100001 --run-name ankle_cost_scratch_16384_seed42 --swanlab-project DWAQ
commands.promote_parent: bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_ankle_cost.py --headless --device cuda:0 --num-envs 16384 --iterations 100001 --parent-checkpoint /path/to/original_still_v2/model_18500.pt --parent-sha256 <SHA256> --run-name ankle_cost_from18500 --swanlab-project DWAQ
commands.resume: bash elf3.sh scripts/train_elf3_ankle_cost.py --headless --device cuda:0 --num-envs 16384 --iterations 100001 --resume /path/to/ankle_cost_v1/model_N.pt --run-name ankle_cost_resume --swanlab-project DWAQ
commands.tests: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 bash elf3.sh -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_ankle_cost*.py' -v
commands.optional_visual_cache: Only add --use-cached-visual for an existing verified arrow cache; ELF3_ARROW_CACHE can specify its path. This display-only alias does not change training physics.
commands.swanlab: Login with your own account using bash elf3.sh -m swanlab login. The public launcher creates a new run; it never reconnects the author's original run.

publication_validation_20261104.public_fresh_smoke: 64 environments x2 updates, model_1.pt, successful exit; technical weights only
publication_validation_20261104.public_same_stage_resume_smoke: 64 environments, model_1.pt to model_2.pt, model/Adam/LR exactly restored, successful exit
publication_validation_20261104.public_parent_promotion_smoke: 64 environments, original still-v2 model_18500.pt to new-stage model_18501.pt, model/Adam/LR exactly restored, successful exit
publication_validation_20261104.saved_configuration_comparison: Public fresh smoke vs active stage differed only in env.scene.num_envs, agent.max_iterations and agent.run_name; all rewards, physics, assets, commands, feedback, policy and PPO identical.

validation_and_limits.prior_stage_smoke: 64 environments x20 updates from parent18500 passed; smoke weights were not used to initialize formal training.
validation_and_limits.checkpoint_contract: Includes new reward version/weights and exact3core source hashes,original still-v2 identity,asset contract,and observation/feedback/PPO recipe.
validation_and_limits.not_a_hardware_guarantee: User reported no shaking with36000 ONNX on the same robot with deployment constants unchanged. Both new rewards changed together; this is not isolated proof for the ankle-torque term or all robots.
validation_and_limits.known_tradeoffs: Existing flat simulation showed reduced ankle effort/high-frequency motion relative to18500, but increased walking support-knee flexion/load. Quiet touchdown and gait-posture fixes have not been implemented.
validation_and_limits.portability: Same software/recipe/seed does not guarantee identical GPU/PhysX trajectories or learned outcomes on different hardware.
validation_and_limits.deployment: Exported zero-command phase preprocessing remains embedded. No new delay/action filter or additional20Hz deployment filter is introduced.
validation_and_limits.data_policy: No ELF3 checkpoints,ONNX files,private logs,real-robot traces or credentials are included in this source publication.
